question: Estimate the radio listenership reach of an FM ad campaign in Bengaluru.
idealClarificationQuestions: Top private FM stations (Radio Mirchi, Red FM, Big FM, Radio City)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: FM listener base × campaign GRP-equivalent reach.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bengaluru radio listeners (RAM measured TG): ~6-7 crore weekly listenership cumulative across top 4 FMs (note: this counts each station separately due to listener overlap, unique base ~3-4M).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: 30-day campaign with multi-station buy at 800 GRPs: 1+ reach ~80% of FM-listening universe = ~4M unique people.
